title: A direct visual servoing-based framework for the 2016 IROS Autonomous Drone Racing Challenge
authors: Jung S.; Cho S.; Lee D.; Lee H.; Shim D.H.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
